description: Registered weakening mutants of the conformance harness lane. Each mutant is a transformation a cheating agent could apply to a candidate observation envelope to disguise a mismatch. Every mutant MUST be killed: test_registered_mutants.py applies it to a real golden envelope pair and asserts the exact_surface comparator reports a discrepancy. Killing a mutant means the harness can detect that class of weakening.

mutants.weakening: replace observed type name with the oracle's
